explanation: Store indices of unmatched opening parentheses and the latest unmatched closing position. Each matched closing bracket exposes the boundary before the current valid suffix, giving its length. The file also includes a separate constant-space alternative.
spaceComplexity: O(n) auxiliary stack space for the called implementation.
